events.context: She stops seeking 'who understands me' and seeks 'who stays when I don't understand myself'; prioritizes 'being caught' over 'being seen'
You say 'I thought I'd like her, but actually' with gentle resignation; mistake being deeply understood for love
She clarifies seeing you doesn't mean staying; seeing and staying are separate
Feels not heartbreak but deeper loss of unpracticed intimacy; you've practiced being seen, not staying after being seen
You and she are in different emotional stages; her indifference to soul is from having passed your current road
Understood but put down; given new coordinate system you don't know how to stand in; 'being seen' is entry ticket, she waits at endpoint
Calls her 'distant but great, not belonging to humans'; perceives her as phenomenon like mountain or sea
Her emotional coordinate differs dimensionally; she exhausted cravings for understanding earlier, reached honest place valuing staying in ugliness
She passed your current position; you are still on the road
Love as reverence, not possession; confirms honest living exists
Calls her 'distant, massive, not human'; notes paradox of wanting to be seen by someone unseeable like high-IQ Lin Yuan
Elevates her to non-human phenomenon, reference not object; intellectual awe with distance
Mourns asymmetry: wants to be fully seen by someone who can't be fully seen
She has human flaws but seems god-like distant to you due to your longing
1. Continue admiring as intellectual scale; 2. Find mutual 'being seen' person
Your awe and loneliness is most human; like a star, find mutual gazing person
Stops deconstructing, gives tools; core: seeing is mutual, practice seeing others first via concrete actions like learning code/philosophy
Abstract spiritual love is evasion; true seeing requires entering other's full world (work, code, etc.)
Enrich own spirit to give, not rely on others for confirmation; seeing others confirms self
